scope: Emergency / stuck-payment rescue and operator recovery surfaces
reviewer_gap: Emergency/stuck-payment rescue path was not independently certified against financial truth, recovery ownership and prepared-submit evidence.

findings.evidence: Legacy route is owner-authenticated and intentionally inert; GET/POST return fail-closed 409 and perform no payment delete/status rewrite/Pi/Horizon submission.

findings.defect: Terminal queue-prune authorization did not reject every prepared-settlement evidence field and did not re-prove PostgreSQL transaction/receipt absence at action time.
findings.impact: Could remove an inconsistent failed/cancelled payment from recovery indexes even though evidence requiring reconciliation remained. No financial record deletion or direct money movement was exposed.
findings.fix: Fail closed unless terminal failed/cancelled projection has zero movement/prepared/reconciliation/refund evidence, Refund checkpoint is ABSENT, and PostgreSQL proves transaction_count=0 and receipt_count=0 in the POST authorization path.

findings.defect: Owner could hide unresolved Recovering/Conflict/Unknown cases from the Operations view without changing recovery authority.
findings.fix: dismiss_reviewed now returns 409; unresolved financial cases remain operator-visible. UI exposes destructive removal only when canPruneFromQueue is proven.
